howItWorks.waBody: {name} has missed their check-in. Please verify their well-being as soon as possible.

1.title: Add your loved one
1.body: Enter their name, mobile number and address so we know who to check in on.

2.title: Send them their personal link
2.body: We create a login link just for them — no password needed. Copy it and send it on WhatsApp or SMS.

3.title: They check in with one tap
3.body: Each day, your loved one opens their link and taps how they're feeling. They'll see an encouraging message after.

4.title: See how they're doing at a glance
4.body: Your dashboard shows everyone's latest check-in and mood, so you can spot when something's off.

5.title: Get a WhatsApp alert if they miss a day
5.body: If your loved one misses a day, HeartBeat messages you on WhatsApp straight away, using the number on your CareCompass account.
